post.title: Pre-qualified vs pre-approved: neither is a loan
post.ig:
That pre-approved letter isn't a loan. Neither is pre-qualified.

The CFPB says lenders use the two terms differently, and neither letter is a guaranteed loan offer. Often, prequalification uses self-reported numbers and preapproval uses verified documents.
myFICO: one hard inquiry takes less than 5 points off most people's FICO scores. Mortgage, auto and student loan shopping within 14 or 45 days (depending on FICO version) counts as one inquiry.
Example: 3 mortgage lenders in 14 days = 1 inquiry, not 3.
Prescreened card mail: opt out at OptOutPrescreen.com or 1-888-5-OPT-OUT (1-888-567-8688) for 5 years or permanently (FTC).

Sources: CFPB, myFICO, FTC (incl. FTC v. Credit Karma, Sept 2022; Credit Karma disagreed with the allegations).
